capabilities: Evaluate Clojure and ClojureScript code blocks and print output inside or outside the block
Start and connect to a Babashka nREPL server
Expose vault bindings for the current file to evaluated code
Load dependencies from bb.edn and nbb.edn in a configurable vault directory
Kill all running eval and nREPL processes
extras: Users must set absolute paths to the bb, node, and nbb binaries in plugin settings before evaluating code blocks; output can be capped at 1000 lines, and the dependency directory can be moved outside the vault to avoid syncing installed packages.
problem: Obsidian cannot execute Clojure or ClojureScript code blocks, so scripting over vault documents from notes requires leaving the app.

relations.evidence: lets you run Clojure and ClojureScript code blocks via Babashka and Node Babashka
run Clojure and ClojureScript code blocks via Babashka and Node Babashka respectively

requires.name: Babashka (bb) and/or Node with Node Babashka (nbb)

summary: Clojure code runner that evaluates Clojure and ClojureScript code blocks in notes via Babashka and Node Babashka, with vault bindings and an nREPL server.
